# InaiSec

InaiSec is the identity-first IR layer for everything after an alert is confirmed. From security incident to disclosure-ready in minutes.

## Positioning

InaiSec picks up where detection stops. It collects evidence, traces compromised credentials across cloud, SaaS, identity, and data systems, maps blast radius, and prepares disclosure-ready notification evidence. Investigation tools collect logs. Compliance tools tell you who to notify after the fact. InaiSec converges both during the investigation.

## What InaiSec does for an investigation

- Pulls the evidence needed for an active investigation from the systems involved, on demand.
- Traces every identity, role, session, and system touched by the compromised credential.
- Maps blast radius: which systems, which data, which customers, which jurisdictions.
- Generates obligation timers and notification packets aligned with the regulations that apply.
- Keeps every step audit-logged and ready for legal, executive, and regulator review.

## Outcomes

- Hours of manual evidence stitching collapse into minutes.
- Blast radius is known during the investigation, not after.
- Legal and the CISO get disclosure-ready findings in stream with the investigation.
- Credentials used during retrieval are read-only, scoped to the active case, and revocable at any time.

## Founder

Kishore Fernando. Founding security engineer at Databricks (2019–2025), where he built the multi-cloud SIEM and IR infrastructure that ran security operations through hypergrowth and was foundational to FedRAMP High and DoD IL5 authorizations. Previously Sr. Manager, Security Software Engineering at Capital One (2014–2019); co-inventor of 4 security patents. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/kishore-p-fernando

## Design partner program

InaiSec is seeking 3 to 5 paid design partners running real identity investigations. The first session is a discovery conversation about one closed identity-led incident, with no customer data. Any replay on partner data happens only after a written data-handling gate is agreed. Partners get direct founder contact, roadmap influence, and founding-partner commercial terms.
